verdict.rationale: The GST system has a Developer Portal (developer.gst.gov.in/apiportal), so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows the portal's Home, Register, Login and Feedback pages. Nothing documents a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
